subtitle: A fictional study-preparation checklist. Use it to see how structured content becomes a checked document.

sections.title: Gather the preparation notes
items: Use a fictional summary; no certificates or personal documents.
Record whether the demo note is available. Missing is a valid state.
Use the fictional preparation target from the bundled specification.

sections.title: Read the preliminary result
rows: The result lists what is absent.

sections.title: Choose whether to request review
sections.body: The demo creates a CRM-like record only after an explicit review request. Repeating the same request returns the same record.

callout: A complete checklist is not an admission decision. This example has no real university policy behind it.
notice: Synthetic demo data — no real customer information.
